steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each negotiation is placed by its contact, its owner and whether its stage has moved.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 negotiation has had no contact for 14 days

findings.title: No contact for more than 14 days
Stage did not move for two weeks
findings.fix: Set the next step and its date

outcome.notChecked: Whether the counterparty agrees with the status recorded.

pros: Checks a negotiation with no next step, no owner, or no contact for more than 14 days, and a stage that did not move for two weeks.
cons: Not checked: Whether the counterparty agrees with the status recorded.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-neg-weekly-status skill on the records for this review.
